title: Free of Columbia
alt: Eagle's angular silver cabin and gold descent stage float above the curved Moon, with landing legs extended. Columbia recedes into the upper left, leaving a clear gap between the spacecraft.
context: Eagle has separated from Columbia in lunar orbit. Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin are aboard Eagle; Michael Collins remains in Columbia. This composition emphasizes the separation between two spacecraft, with Eagle's ascent and descent stages still joined.
interpretation: Original illustrative viewpoint. Shapes, spacing, surface relief and lighting are stylized, not a to-scale reconstruction or flight telemetry. No latch count, altitude, historical quote or exact separation attitude is asserted by the drawing.

sources.label: Apollo 11 Flight Journal · Undocking and descent-orbit insertion
